newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council agrees positions on ONP voice telephone rules.
newsitem.headline: Council agrees positions on ONP voice telephone rules.

text.p: The Telecommunications Council agreed positions on Thursday on three issues related to legislation that will update EU rules covering voice telephone service, Irish Telecoms Minister Michal Lowry said.

He told a news conference the Council had agreed that the following principles should be incorporated in the draft directive to apply Open Network Provision (ONP) principles to voice telephony, COM(96)419:

-- Member states may ask mobile phone operators to contribute to funds that allow telecoms operators to share the burden of providing "universal service" -- affordable basic telephone service to all residents.
The European Commission had proposed that mobile operators be excluded.
-- Mobile operators should also by covered by provisions in the directive applying to phone directories and customer contracts.
-- Certain parts of the directive impose excessive regulatory requirements and should be diluted following further discussion by COREPER, the EU committee of permanent representatives.
The legislation, COM(96)419, updates Directive 95/62/EC, which regulates the voice telephone sector and outlines a range of services that member states must guarantee as part of "universal service".
